svg.title: p3achii — drawing & game dev
svg.desc: Animated seaside banner (autumn): the name p3achii bobbing in pixel letters, Wooper floating in the waves, autumn leaves falling past the setting sun, and a typewriter cycling through: hi, i'm p3achii ~ / i draw & make games / unity (mostly 3d) · c / c# / currently: live2d rigging / drawing for game dev ✦
